features.name: Provider Quality Scoring Engine
features.description: Deterministic composite scoring engine that aggregates ≥3 provider quality measures into a single score with fixed weighting logic.
features.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py (existing EvaluateCare orchestration layer supports extension for scoring)

features.name: Clinical Trial Quality Scoring Engine
features.description: Deterministic composite scoring engine that aggregates ≥3 clinical trial measures into a single relevance/quality score.

features.name: Score Explainability Engine
features.description: Returns measure-level breakdown including raw values, normalized scores, and contribution to final score.

features.name: Score Explainability Display
features.description: Renders score, measures, and contribution breakdown clearly in chat UI.

features.name: Provider Board Certification Measure
features.description: Scores provider based on presence and relevance of board certifications to queried specialty.

features.name: Provider Experience Measure
features.description: Scores provider based on years in practice derived from graduation year or NPI enumeration.

features.name: Specialty Match Accuracy Measure
features.description: Scores how closely provider taxonomy aligns with user-requested condition or specialty.

features.name: Prescription Behavior Analysis
features.description: Analyzes prescribing patterns relative to treated conditions to identify alignment with standard of care.
features.evidence: ASSUMPTION: No prescription dataset currently present in manifest; requires future integration with claims or public prescribing datasets. GAP: define data source and ingestion pipeline.

features.name: Clinical Trial Phase Measure
features.description: Scores trials based on phase (I–IV) with higher phases indicating stronger evidence maturity.

features.name: Clinical Trial Enrollment Status Measure
features.description: Scores trials based on recruitment status, prioritizing actively recruiting studies.

features.name: Clinical Trial Condition Relevance Measure
features.description: Scores how closely trial conditions match user query or condition intent.

features.name: User Adjustable Quality Weights
features.description: Allows users to adjust importance of measures and recompute score dynamically.
features.evidence: ASSUMPTION: No current UI or backend weighting system exists; requires extension of scoring engine and frontend controls. GAP: define weight persistence and UI interaction model.
